Pricing guide

How much does a restaurant website cost in Boston?

By the Amana Digital USA teamPublished October 8, 2026Updated October 23, 20266 min read

The cost of a restaurant website in Boston depends on who builds it and what it needs to do: a website builder you set up yourself, a freelancer or an agency. At Amana Digital USA, a restaurant website starts from $1,200 and an online store from $2,500. The price goes up with the number of pages, languages, online ordering or reservations, and the content (photos, text) that has to be created.

Key points

  • Amana Digital USA: restaurant websites from $1,200, online stores from $2,500.
  • The main price drivers are pages, languages, online ordering or reservations, and content creation.
  • A restaurant site must show the menu, hours, address, phone and photos clearly on mobile.
  • Ask what is included: domain, hosting, updates, and who owns the site.
  • Online ordering platforms usually charge their own fees on top of the website.
  • A website works best together with a complete Google Business Profile.

What are the options for a restaurant website?

There are three common ways to get a restaurant website. Each one has a different cost and a different amount of work for you.

  • Do it yourself with a website builder: low upfront cost and a monthly subscription, but you do the design, writing and updates yourself.
  • A freelancer: often cheaper than an agency, but quality and availability vary, and you may still need someone for photos, Google and social media.
  • An agency: design, content, Google setup and marketing handled by one team. More expensive in Boston, unless part of the team works remotely.

What does our price include?

Our restaurant websites start from $1,200. Our design and development team is in Agadir, Morocco, and our US Director Abdelouahab Aitelhadj receives clients at our office in Revere. That combination is how we keep agency quality at a small-business price.

A starting website includes a mobile-friendly design, your menu, hours, location and contact buttons, photos, and a clean structure for Google. Extra pages, languages, online ordering or reservations are quoted separately.

What drives the price up?

Four things explain most of the difference between two quotes.

  • Number of pages: one page with everything, or separate pages for menu, catering, events and locations.
  • Languages: each extra language (Spanish, Arabic, French…) adds content to prepare.
  • Online ordering and reservations: links to an existing platform are simple; a custom ordering system costs more.
  • Content: if photos and text need to be created, that is part of the work.

What must a restaurant website include?

Most people visit a restaurant website on their phone, often while deciding where to go right now. Speed and clarity matter more than effects.

  • The menu as real text (not only a PDF), so Google and AI assistants can read it.
  • Hours, address, phone and a directions button, visible without scrolling on a phone.
  • Good photos of your food and your space.
  • Links to order, book or call in one tap.
  • The same name, address and phone as your Google Business Profile.

What should you check in a quote?

Want a quote? See our web development service or call Abdelouahab at +1 (617) 386-9074.

  • Are the domain and hosting included, and for how long?
  • Who owns the website and the domain? (It should be you.)
  • How much do updates cost after launch (new menu, new prices)?
  • Is the site set up for Google and connected to your Google Business Profile?

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

How much does a restaurant website cost in Boston?

It depends on who builds it and what it includes. At Amana Digital USA, restaurant websites start from $1,200; online stores start from $2,500.

Do I need online ordering on my website?

Not always. Many restaurants link to the ordering platform they already use. A custom ordering system is only worth it at higher volumes.

Should my menu be a PDF?

Better as real text on the page, with an optional PDF. Text menus load faster on phones and can be read by Google and AI assistants.

Can you also manage my social media?

Yes. Social media management starts from $600 per month.
